outcomes: In a Gradle repository, Android included, each project the settings include is a component, and the project() and projects.x references of its build file are its edges, without running Gradle
In a Maven repository, each module the POMs list is a component, and a dependency on another module is an edge, without running Maven
The JUnit reports of Gradle, Android and Maven Surefire or Failsafe, and the JaCoCo or Kover coverage reports, land on the components that hold the tests and the covered files
A version bump in a Gradle lockfile or in the version catalog is a dependency change of ecosystem maven
nonGoals: Running Gradle or Maven, evaluating a settings script, a build script or a POM, or reading their caches
Composite builds (includeBuild), buildSrc, convention plugins and the edges a plugin or a subprojects block adds
Resolving Maven parent POMs, BOMs or properties beyond the project's own groupId and properties
Dependency changes of a Maven repository, which has no lockfile: an SBOM gives the licences and vulnerabilities of a lockfile change, not the change itself
Source roots other than src/main and src/test, such as Kotlin Multiplatform's src/commonMain
Serving the detectors over the workspace probe wire or from their own extension: they live in @putnami/observe

requirements.text: A root settings.gradle.kts or settings.gradle makes a Gradle repository. Each project an include call names with string literals is a component of source workspace and ecosystem gradle, named by its project path: :libs:core is libs/core, unless the settings set its projectDir with file("dir") or File(settingsDir or rootDir, "dir"). The root project is one only when the root holds src. An included project without its directory is the observe.gradle_project_missing warning.

In a project's build.gradle.kts or build.gradle, outside comments, each project(":x"), project(path: ":x"), project(path = ":x") or findProject(":x") reference, and each type-safe accessor projects.x, where projects.fooBar names :foo-bar and projects.libs.core names :libs:core, is an edge from the project to the project it names. A relative path is relative to the project. A reference to a project the settings do not include is no edge.

An include argument or a projectDir value that is not a string literal, such as a variable, a template, a loop or a function reference, is the observe.gradle_dynamic_settings warning naming the settings file, and the projects the settings name with literals stay components. The word include inside a string or a comment is no include.

A root pom.xml makes a Maven repository. The modules or subprojects a POM lists, in the project and its profiles, are read recursively from the pom.xml of their directory or the POM file they name. Each POM whose packaging is not pom is a component of source workspace and ecosystem maven, named groupId:artifactId, the groupId inherited from its parent. A module without a POM or outside the repository is observe.maven_module_missing, a POM that does not parse observe.maven_pom_invalid.

Each dependency of a component's POM, in the project or in its profiles, whose groupId and artifactId name another module of the repository is an edge to that module. ${project.groupId}, ${pom.groupId}, ${project.parent.groupId} and the POM's own properties are resolved first. A dependency of dependencyManagement or of a plugin is no edge.

A JUnit case whose class name, without its $ nested part, names a .java or .kt file under src/test/java, src/test/kotlin, src/androidTest/java or src/androidTest/kotlin of a component goes to that component, the report's own component first. A JaCoCo file, its package path and source file name, maps to the first component whose src/main/java or src/main/kotlin holds it, the report's own component first.

Discovery recognizes a JaCoCo XML report by its report root and finds the reports Gradle, Android and Maven write: build/test-results, build/outputs/androidTest-results, build/reports/jacoco, target/surefire-reports, target/failsafe-reports and target/site/jacoco. It skips the build outputs that hold no report: build/intermediates, build/generated, build/tmp and build/kotlin, and target/classes, target/test-classes, target/generated-sources and target/generated-test-sources.

A gradle.lockfile or settings-gradle.lockfile gives each group:artifact:version line its group:artifact and version. A version catalog, a .versions.toml file in a gradle directory, gives each library its group:artifact and each plugin its id, at the version its entry, version.ref or rich version (strictly, require, prefer) states; an entry without one is no package. Both are dependency changes of ecosystem maven, and a maven package URL of an SBOM matches them by group:artifact.

On a Gradle repository whose Kotlin projects :api and :app, an Android library, depend on :pricing, where a change edits pricing and bumps a library in gradle/libs.versions.toml and in the pricing gradle.lockfile, the components are the three projects, api and app are dependent, the JUnit and JaCoCo reports land on them with no unattributed case and no unmapped file, and both bumps are maven dependency changes.

On a Maven repository whose module api depends on the module pricing, where a change edits pricing, the components are the two modules, api is dependent, and the Surefire and JaCoCo reports land on them with no unattributed case and no unmapped file.
